source: Proposal defense presentation (Proposal_defense_narrow.pptx), slides 5 and 7; GIFs converted to silent MP4.

clips.title: A drone in a simulated urban wind field
clips.description: Seen from above, a four-rotor drone hovers over a small park beside a tall stone building. A colored wind field covers the ground: blue bands along the street at left, and yellow, orange, and red patches across the park, with bare trees and street lamps. The drone moves a short distance across the park.
clips.credit: Proposal defense presentation, slide 5. Animated GIF converted to silent MP4; the simulator's toolbar and status text are cropped out.
clips.scope: Simulation visualization; the colors show the simulated wind field, not measured wind.

clips.title: A real multirotor drone flying outdoors
clips.description: Filmed from the ground, a multirotor drone flies against a clear blue sky. As it moves across the frame, bare winter trees come into view along the bottom.
clips.credit: Proposal defense presentation, slide 5. Embedded video scaled to 1280 by 720; the audio track is removed.
clips.scope: Real outdoor flight shown as context; it does not run the study's policy.

clips.title: Wind prediction across a city block
clips.description: The camera flies over a rendered city block between brick and stone buildings. A colored wind prediction covers the streets and a park: a broad yellow and blue band follows the main street, and red patches spread across the open ground. The view turns and descends toward the park, passing trees and street lamps.
clips.credit: Proposal defense presentation, slide 7. Animated GIF converted to silent MP4 at its original size and speed.
clips.scope: Simulation visualization; colors show predicted wind, not measured wind.
